content.title: Warner Bros.
content.text: Vanessa FasanellaI loved this movie. I was entranced. I didn't blink. I laughed, gasped, cried, and cheered. But I never look away. I couldn't. It was that good.93Robert StamperWhen I saw this I thought Penn's part was too much,,,,but then I see the guy from Ice,Bovino acting like Penn in the movie...113Maribeth JonesI'm hard to please, and this film drew me in immediately. At one point I realized my jaw was down and mouth open. Yes. Excellent story about a good guy on a mission.39Rebecca KalalI found this movie to be just amazing, especially in the acting and the pacing. Not to mention, I live in Eureka, California, near where many of the scenes were filmed. For example, Leonardo DiCaprio‘s frustrating phone call using a pay phone was filmed at Murphy’s Market in Cutten just a few blocks away.￼ And when his character emerges from the tunnel beneath his home, he emerges onto a corner of Sequoia Park in Eureka. Fun! And Eureka High School is very real!6521Patrick ConwayI couldn't get past the beginning with old man Penn and his woody. Nuff said.294Mitchel SeffI don’t get the hype? The acting was excellent. The action was good. What was lacking was the plot, purpose and finality of the movie. I get the idea of big brother and deep state but that can’t be the only point. I enjoyed it but wondered what happened when it was over. The one part I enjoyed was the possible reference to Gregory Bovino and his imminent demise 7Jeremy ClarkI keep hearing mixed buzz about this film. I’m going to watch it anyway sometime this week, and make up my own mind, but it seems like people love it or hate it. I like almost everything Paul Thomas Anderson has directed, but this one has really divided viewers. What do you think? Just curious.6Anne McMenemyLoved this...Sean Penn deserves an award for hi excellent part...181
